english_paragraphs: Charles Darwin disembarked from HMS Beagle in October 1836. In September 1838 he began formulating the principle of natural selection: individuals better adapted to their surroundings survive and pass on their hereditary traits. By 1844 he had composed a 230-page manuscript, yet kept it unpublished, cautiously amassing evidence.

In February 1858, two decades after Darwin's first insight, Alfred Russel Wallace, a naturalist afflicted by fever in the Malay Archipelago, independently conceived the same idea. His concise essay reached Darwin on 18 June 1858. Its argument paralleled Darwin's own almost precisely; he told Charles Lyell he had never seen a more remarkable coincidence. His claim to priority seemed threatened.

Lyell and the botanist Joseph Hooker arranged for both papers to be read simultaneously at the Linnean Society, a scientific institution in London, on 1 July 1858. Neither author attended the proceedings. Wallace was abroad, and Darwin was grieving: scarlet fever had killed his infant son on 28 June. The compromise, struck without Wallace, may have kept rivalry over precedence at bay.

The papers' publication on 20 August 1858 met a muted reception. In May 1859 the Society's president remarked in his yearly address that the year had been barren of revolutionary discoveries. The sensation came on 24 November 1859 with Darwin's treatise, On the Origin of Species: booksellers had subscribed for every copy of its first impression, 1,250 in all.

Wallace had readily signified his acceptance in October 1858, assuring Hooker in a cordial letter of his satisfaction with the arrangement. In 1889 he published a lengthy exposition of the idea and entitled it Darwinism. Wallace never named the theory after himself.
chinese_paragraphs: 1836年10月，查尔斯·达尔文从小猎犬号下船。1838年9月，他开始形成自然选择原理：更能适应环境的个体存活下来，把遗传性状传给后代。到1844年，他已写出230页手稿，却没有发表，仍谨慎地积累证据。
1858年2月，也就是达尔文最初产生这个想法约二十年后，博物学家阿尔弗雷德·拉塞尔·华莱士在马来群岛身患热病时，独立想到了同一原理。他的简短论文于1858年6月18日送达达尔文手中，论证与达尔文自己的几乎完全一致。达尔文告诉查尔斯·莱尔，他从未见过如此惊人的巧合。他对首创地位的主张，似乎受到了威胁。
莱尔和植物学家约瑟夫·胡克安排两人的论文于1858年7月1日在伦敦的科学机构林奈学会上同场宣读。两位作者都没有到场：华莱士身在海外，达尔文则正沉浸在悲痛中——6月28日，猩红热夺走了他幼子的生命。这个在华莱士未参与商定的情况下达成的折中办法，或许避免了一场首创权之争。
论文于1858年8月20日发表，反响平淡。1859年5月，学会会长甚至在年度致辞中说，这一年没有革命性的发现。真正的轰动直到1859年11月24日达尔文的专著《物种起源》出版时才到来：书商已把首印的1250册全部订走。
华莱士已于1858年10月欣然表示接受这一安排，并在写给胡克的亲切信件中说明自己对此感到满意。1889年，他又出版了一部详细阐述这一思想的著作，题名《达尔文主义》。他从未用自己的名字为这套理论命名。

illustration_prompt:
Create a single publication-quality landscape 3:2 narrative illustration for an adult illustrated English-reading booklet. Finished standalone artwork, not a book mockup, not a collage of multiple unrelated panels. Sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache and watercolor, carefully controlled colored-pencil accents, velvety matte paint, subtle warm paper texture, soft natural daylight. Warm ivory paper dominates; subdued eucalyptus and sage greens structure the composition; restrained buttery lemon-yellow and dusty terracotta accents. Calm, comfortable, refined, credible drawing and natural anatomy. An airy coherent composition with one clear story focal point and at most two supporting details, generous breathing room at all edges and softly feathered painted edges into ivory. Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Show the particular article's pivotal event or mechanism rather than a generic portrait or generic textbook symbols. Human figures treated with dignity; no grotesque caricature, no sensational violence or visible injuries. For disasters, emphasize the setting, evidence or human response without graphic suffering. For uncertain scientific claims, depict the observations and investigation without presenting debated mechanisms as proven. Absolutely no typography, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagram labels, fake writing or invented charts anywhere. Do not render invisible forces as literal magic. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.

ARTICLE-SPECIFIC SCENE:
Darwin at his study desk in June 1858, pausing in genuine quiet surprise over a newly arrived letter and short essay from Wallace. Portray Darwin as a historically appropriate middle-aged man of forty-nine with receding brown hair and sideburns, CLEAN-SHAVEN rather than the long white beard of his later life. He wears a dark mid-Victorian coat; his natural hands hold the letter with only its completely blank reverse visible to the viewer. The focal story is the unexpected independent idea reaching a scientist who has kept his own manuscript private. A modest tied bundle of manuscript pages, seen edge-on without writing, and a small natural-history specimen tray are the only supporting details. Wallace is not in the room; do not depict a meeting that did not occur. No book title, legible paper, tree-of-life diagram or invented handwriting. Calm ivory, sage and restrained walnut tones, dignified adult editorial watercolor.

华莱士独立构想同一原理，1858年来稿几乎与达尔文一致，令达尔文担心自己的首创地位。
莱尔、胡克安排两人成果于1858年7月同场宣读；两位作者都未出席，华莱士也未参与商定办法。
论文发表初期反响冷淡；1859年《物种起源》引起轰动，首印1250册已被书商全部订购。
华莱士1858年10月事后致信认可安排；1889年又以《达尔文主义》阐述自然选择，未用自己名字命名理论。
